name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Digital Marketing Strategist & Multi-Account Portfolio Manager
summary: Marketing strategist with 15+ years managing digital marketing, lead generation, and performance reporting for a portfolio of client accounts, most recently as founder of Solenzo. Builds and executes SEO, paid media, and conversion-optimization strategy, and translates performance data into budget and investment recommendations for stakeholders. Prior tenure at Birdeye included guiding customers through reputation-management platform setup, direct experience with the online reputation management this role calls for.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.
Optimize a client's Google Ads account and diagnose on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck.
Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword gap analyses, and competitor research using Screaming Frog, implementing fixes directly inside client CMS platforms.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive stakeholders.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Guided customers through setup and configuration of reputation-management and marketing-automation tools.
Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led a 20-person, later 8-person, onboarding team for 2 years, owning budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
